sql.leaveEditor: Esc, then Tab to leave the editor

sql.offline: No connection: the sandbox will load once the connection is back.
sql.right: Right. The result matches the reference.

assist.waitingUnderstanding: The assistant is reading your explanation and checking it against the chapter. Usually 10–40 seconds.
assist.waitingSql: The assistant is looking into your query. Usually 5–30 seconds.
assist.truncated: The answer was cut at its length limit. Ask to continue in the question field.
assist.dailyLimit: Today’s assistant limit is used up: {limit} of {limit}. New answers {when}.
assist.dailyLimitUnknown: Today’s assistant limit is used up. New answers {when}.

assist.unavailable: The assistant is not answering right now. Try again — everything else in the book works as usual.
assist.offline: No connection: the assistant did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
assist.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again to ask the assistant.
assist.forbidden: The assistant did not answer: this chapter is no longer open to you.
assist.notFound: The section changed while the page was open. Reload the page.
assist.invalid: The assistant did not accept this request. Change the text and try again.
assist.tooLarge: This request is too large for the assistant. Shorten it and ask again.
assist.heroNote: Under every section heading there is an “Explain it differently” button: the assistant retells the section more simply, through another analogy, with a new code example or as an interview answer. At the end of a chapter you can test yourself by explaining the main points in your own words.

ownWords.label: Explain it in your own words · with the assistant
ownWords.instruction: Without looking at the text, explain the main points of this chapter as if to a colleague or an interviewer. The assistant compares your explanation with the chapter and tells you what you got right, what you missed and what to reread.
ownWords.tooShort: Too short: write at least 2–3 sentences ({min} characters or more) so there is something to check.
